verdict.rationale: Anytype documents its own import feature, including a Markdown/Obsidian path that creates one object per Markdown file, so the plain-Markdown part of the story is delivered. Nothing in the evidence covers Notion, Evernote or Roam sources, or whether links, structure and attachments survive import. A hands-on user also reports Markdown import is painful (one file at a time, a confusing zip option). Missing for 10: documented Notion/Evernote/Roam importers, evidence that internal links, hierarchy and attachments are preserved, and smooth bulk import confirmed hands-on.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my existing notes from Notion, Evernote, Roam, or plain Markdown with structure, links, and attachments preserved

citations.quote: You can import content into your spaces and export it at any time.
Anytype will process the contents and automatically create a separate object for each Markdown file.
Open Channel Settings → Import → Obsidian and click on Import files.
